lead: Recent developments in health technology highlight both advancements and challenges, particularly in AI applications and wearable devices.

stories.title: Doctors’ AI scribes get names of drugs and diagnoses wrong, NHS watchdog warns
stories.summary: An NHS watchdog has raised concerns about AI scribes used in medical consultations, which have been found to misreport drug names and diagnoses. Patients have identified errors that were overlooked by healthcare professionals, leading to potential risks. One alarming case involved a misdiagnosis of serious nerve damage, highlighting the critical need for accuracy in AI applications within healthcare.

stories.title: Grindr wants to be the everything app for gay men; investors are still deciding whether it can pull it off
stories.summary: Grindr is evolving beyond its dating roots, aiming to become a comprehensive platform for gay men, integrating features related to healthcare and social networking. CEO George Arison discusses the potential of AI and a new subscription tier to enhance user experience. This ambitious pivot raises questions about the viability of such a multifaceted app in a competitive market.

stories.title: Why the Hottest New Wearables Want to Be Ignored
stories.summary: A new wave of minimalist wearables is emerging, designed to track health data without overwhelming users with notifications. These devices aim to provide essential health insights while promoting a less intrusive user experience. This trend reflects a growing desire for technology that respects users' attention and mental well-being.

stories.title: Health hands enterprise computing to Leidos in $91m deal
stories.summary: The health sector is transitioning its enterprise computing operations to Leidos in a significant $91 million deal, marking the end of a long-term partnership with Datacom. This move is expected to enhance efficiency and innovation in health IT services, reflecting the industry's ongoing digital transformation.

stories.title: Oura Ring 5 review: a stunning generational leap for smart rings
stories.summary: The new Oura Ring 5 has set a high standard for health-tracking wearables, featuring a slimmer design and improved functionality. It offers enhanced comfort and usability, making it a practical choice for users. However, the device comes with a subscription model that may deter some potential buyers.

stories.title: Musk’s faster path to more gas turbines comes with pollution problem
stories.summary: Elon Musk's new initiative to accelerate gas turbine production has raised environmental concerns, as the associated pollution impacts health. The project aims to streamline energy production but faces scrutiny from health advocates and environmentalists. This highlights the ongoing tension between technological advancement and public health.

stories.title: 3 surveys deliver the same uncomfortable truth about adopting agentic AI
stories.summary: Recent surveys reveal that the integration of AI in business, including healthcare, is fraught with challenges related to accountability and governance. The findings suggest that successful AI adoption requires a balanced relationship between humans and technology. This is particularly crucial in health sectors where trust and accuracy are paramount.
